name: The End of the Summer "Saigo no Natsu"
original_name: The End of the Summer「最後の夏」
source: A tale of two sisters, "The End of the Summer" is a meditation on how we face loss — be it the dramatic disappearance of a family's housecat, or the slow wearing away that can go unnoticed for years at a stretch.
